_comment: The structural sanity check for target_reps and target_load (#99 follow-up), stated once.
There is no shared runtime between the API and the SPA, so the rule itself is implemented
comment in each pointing at the other is not a guarantee that they agree; this file is.
Both test suites read it and assert every case, so a rule that drifts in one language fails
a test in the other rather than being discovered by a trainer.
Add cases here first. The corpus is shared, the wording of the rejection is not — each
layer owns its own sentence, and only accept/reject is asserted from here.
It sits beside the TypeScript implementation rather than in a neutral tests/shared/ for one
reason: reading it from outside the Vite root would need node's fs in a file under src/, and
the only way to type that is to add @types/node to tsconfig.app.json — which would also let
application code import fs into a browser bundle. A fixture's location is a smaller price
